scope.name: Web Application
scope.expected: Parameterized queries and input validation tests

scope.name: Database Server
scope.expected: Firewall allowlist and restricted database permissions

scope.name: Enterprise Network
scope.expected: Documented firewall rules and periodic rule reviews

scope.name: User Authentication System
scope.expected: Role-based access control and MFA for administrators

findings.title: SQL Injection Risk
findings.observation: The initial audit script identifies SQL injection as a risk. Application code and database queries have not yet been tested.
findings.evidence: E-01: Initial audit script output; application test evidence pending.
findings.gap: Parameterized queries and input validation have not been verified.
findings.action: Review database queries; use parameterized queries; run authorized input-validation tests.
findings.verification: Code review and documented safe test results

findings.title: Administrative Access Control Risk
findings.observation: The initial audit script flags administrative access control. Actual account permissions and MFA settings have not been inspected.
findings.evidence: E-01: Initial audit script output; account review pending.
findings.gap: Role separation, least privilege, and administrator MFA require verification.
findings.action: Review admin accounts; remove unnecessary privileges; enable MFA and test access restrictions.
findings.verification: Approved account inventory and access-control test results

findings.title: Database Service Exposure Risk
findings.observation: The initial audit script flags possible database exposure. No port scan or firewall configuration evidence is included yet.
findings.evidence: E-01: Initial audit script output; firewall evidence pending.
findings.gap: Allowed source addresses, exposed services, and firewall rules need review.
findings.action: Review approved firewall rules; restrict database connections to authorized application hosts.
findings.verification: Firewall review record and authorized connectivity test

findings.title: Security Monitoring Gap
findings.observation: The initial audit script flags insufficient monitoring. Log collection and alerting configurations have not been inspected.
findings.evidence: E-01: Initial audit script output; log review evidence pending.
findings.gap: Centralized logs, alert rules, retention, and review responsibilities require verification.
findings.action: Define log sources; centralize relevant logs; configure alerts and a review schedule.
findings.verification: Sample log records, test alert, and documented review procedure

evidence_note: Initial script output is supporting evidence only. Technical validation evidence must be collected separately.
